@@ -105,6 +106,52 @@
 WikiNamespace = Union[Namespace, int]
 
 
+class _Urllib3Session:
+    def __init__(self, headers: dict[str, str], **kwargs) -> None:
+        self.headers = headers
+        self._request_kwargs = kwargs
+        self._pool = urllib3.PoolManager(retries=False)
+        self._proxy_pools: dict[str, urllib3.ProxyManager] = {}
+
+    def _pool_for_url(self, url: str):
+        proxies = self._request_kwargs.get("proxies")
+        if not proxies:
+            return self._pool
+
+        scheme = parse.urlsplit(url).scheme
+        proxy_url = proxies.get(scheme)
+        if proxy_url:
+            if proxy_url not in self._proxy_pools:
+                self._proxy_pools[proxy_url] = urllib3.ProxyManager(proxy_url, retries=False)
+            return self._proxy_pools[proxy_url]
+
+        return self._pool
+
+    def get(self, url: str, params=None, **kwargs):
+        request_kwargs = dict(self._request_kwargs)
+        request_kwargs.update(kwargs)
+        request_kwargs.pop("proxies", None)
+
+        headers = dict(self.headers)
+        extra_headers = request_kwargs.pop("headers", None)
+        if extra_headers:
+            headers.update(extra_headers)
+
+        pool = self._pool_for_url(url)
+        return pool.request(
+            "GET",
+            url,
+            fields=params,
+            headers=headers,
+            **request_kwargs,
+        )
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._pool.clear()
+        for pool in self._proxy_pools.values():
+            pool.clear()
+
